verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party Gmail feature for importing mail history or contacts from another provider or client. The only related item lists "email account migration" as a Gmail API use case, which is a developer building block rather than a product import capability. IMAP/POP support covers third-party clients reading Gmail, not importing into it, and contacts import is never mentioned.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
